sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
The chest rig is based on a real Ferro Concepts FCPC V5 plate carrier configured with numerous commercially available Ferro Concepts accessories. In addition to the FCPC V5 base, the configuration shown in-game includes:
- Ferro Concepts ADAPT 3" Assault Cummerbund (3AC)
  - With Ferro Concepts 3AC Side Plate Pockets 6X6 on the insides
- Ferro Concepts Roll 1 Trauma Pouch mounted beneath the front flap as an IFAK for medical supplies
- Ferro Concepts KTAR Front Flap, a triple rifle magazine placard mounted to the front of the carrier
- Ferro Concepts Wingman V2 wing pouches and 3AC 6x6 Side Plate Pockets mounted to the cummerbund
- Ferro Concepts Shoulder Pads.

The model is also depicted carrying an AN/PRC-148 Multiband Inter/Intra Team Radio, AN/PRC-152 Multiband Handheld Radio, a TEA U94 Gen II Push-to-Talk (PTT), and a Samsung S23 Tactical Edition mounted in a Juggernaut Case PALS Armor Mount.

Other visible accessories include a North American Rescue (NAR) CAT Tourniquet, NAR ARS Decompression Needle, ASP Tri-Fold Restraints with both the Molded Pull (black) and Key Ring Pull (rescue orange) retention variants, and utility pouches.
